messages:
maria_ae: Kicking off FinCo POC thread. Need alignment on success criteria, cost guardrails, and security handoff.
ben_se: Quick summary: two features - abstractive summarization (user-facing) and search rescoring (backend). Expected baseline traffic ~200 rps, spikes up to ~800.
aj_devex: What are acceptable SLOs for the POC?
maria_ae: Proposal: summary p95 <= 350ms for up to 512 tokens, reranker p95 <= 120ms. Cost cap: target <= $3k/week, reserve $4k/week as buffer. Quality: offline pass rate >= 88%, hallucination < 1.5%.
sam_ml: For clarity add metrics: usefulness mean >= 4.0 (1-5), factuality failure rate <2% on spot checks, reranker NDCG@10 >= 0.85. We'll keep semantic-sim regression checks.
ben_se: Acceptance path: offline eval (1k labeled samples) + 1-week staging canary sampling live traffic? Also security: VPC + customer KMS mandatory?
maria_ae: Yes to both. No external network from model pods. Canary must be sampled traffic with manual rollback trigger.
aj_devex: I'll prepare eval harness and versioned prompt set. Suggested baseline command:
```bash
python tools/run_eval.py --model redwood-instruct-13b-quant --prompts data/finco_eval.json \
  --metrics usefulness,factuality,ndcg --out results/finco_baseline.json
```
aj_devex: We'll tag prompts/finco in git. Do we want streaming enabled for summary during acceptance?
ben_se: Recommend non-streaming for initial acceptance to simplify p95 measurement. Streaming later okay.
olivia_sre: Ops needs: runbook (healthchecks, rollback, throttles), canary rota, and monitoring dashboards. Also confirm whether FinCo will request SOC2 artifacts; that changes scope.
ci-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-blue -> canary-green 2026-06-01T02:00Z
ben_se: Cost notes: avg summary ~250 tokens => ~5M tokens/day at 200 rps. I'll share a token cost calc and quantized vs full model delta. Maria confirm budget.
maria_ae: Confirmed $4k/week contingency. If burn >$3.5k/wk enable stricter batching and fall back to quantized model.
sam_ml: Plan: start redwood-instruct-13B-quant; keep 33B as fallback. We'll log similarity scores and hallucination flags per response.
aj_devex: Action items: aj_devex: deliver eval harness + prompt set (3 business days); sam_ml: baseline model outputs + quant profiles (5 business days); ben_se: cost spreadsheet + runbook PR (2 business days); olivia_sre: on-call rota + rollback playbook (4 business days); maria_ae: confirm labeled eval dataset delivery from FinCo (EOD tomorrow).
ben_se: I'll add an acceptance checklist to the runbook top: metrics, dataset link, baseline artifact, rollback steps, budget guardrails.
aj_devex: I'll include regen tests and hallucination detectors as merge blockers.
olivia_sre: If FinCo requests formal audits (SOC2/ISO) flag security/legal. That will push timeline.
maria_ae: For now POC excludes audits; will escalate if requested.
ben_se: Tentative timeline: runbook + eval ready by 2026-06-05; canary start target 2026-06-12. Any objections?
sam_ml: Timeline OK.
aj_devex: OK.
olivia_sre: Ops OK.
maria_ae: Great. I'll update FinCo with the acceptance targets and dataset ETA. Tagging contact when artifact arrives. :thumbsup:
ben_se: Opening PR for runbook checklist and linking cost calc.
aj_devex: Updating task board and will drop harness link here when ready.
